senses.en: the person or people being addressed

ex.en: Please let me know when you arrive home safely.
ex.zh: 你平安到家后请告诉我。

ex.en: Please wake me before you leave for work.
ex.zh: 请在你出门上班前叫醒我。

entries.tip: you 可表示单数或复数，作主语和宾语形式相同。
entries.note: 补充词卡：释义经本次补充整理；双语例句来自原词库。

senses.en: Short form of you will.

ex.en: You'll find fresh bread in the bakery section.
ex.zh: 你可以在烘焙区找到新鲜面包。

ex.en: You'll find the full recipe in the appendix.
ex.zh: 你可以在附录里找到完整的食谱。

entries.tip: you'll 是 you will 的缩写；根据上下文理解时态和含义。
entries.note: 补充词卡：英语常用缩写；双语例句来自原词库。

senses.en: Short form of you are.

ex.en: You're bound to feel tired after such a long walk.
ex.zh: 走了这么远的路，你肯定会觉得累。

entries.tip: you're 是 you are 的缩写；根据上下文理解时态和含义。
